round_27_status: P1#1 FindingLedger lifecycle: new OBSERVED/DISPATCHED/ACTIVE/SUPERSEDED/REPAIRED states. Round-26 conflated 'placed in a directive' with 'addressed by the worker'; round-27 explicitly forbids that. A failed worker launch, crash, timeout, no-op, or worker that exits without pushing MUST leave the same-head finding ACTIVE so the next round re-emits it. 11 new tests cover the lifecycle end-to-end.

P1#2 Mutable-gate re-fetch: the locked transaction now performs REAL gh queries for ALL four mutable gates via MutableGateSnapshot: fetch_live_pr_payload, fetch_live_required_ci, fetch_live_review_state, fetch_live_thread_inventory. Each gate has its own _safe_run call; a fetch failure raises MergeGateFetchError (no broad exception swallow, no None placeholders, no caller-supplied stale snapshots masquerading as re-fetches). 7 new tests exercise the production-path gates.

P1#3 Orchestration state root: removed silent STATE_DIR fallback. _resolve_orchestration_state_root fails closed when neither env nor RUN_STATE is configured. supervisor's read_run_state persists orchestration_state_root on first read so the relay can discover run_context.json automatically. 1 new production-path test with no env var proves the supervisor-init discovers the real run_context.json automatically.

P1#4 OID validation: any missing/malformed/unreachable OID now persists a PARTIAL recovery record and raises MergeAmbiguousOutcome regardless of server-side merge confirmation. The earlier 'subprocess zero + no merge confirmation' path that raised MergeSubprocessFailed is gone. The public require_oid_reachable=False bypass is REMOVED; tests opt out via the private _set_bypass_oid_reachability(True) seam. 8 new tests cover malformed/missing/unreachable server OIDs and the success-path AMBIGUOUS branch.

P1#5 Controller rebind atomicity: report_repair_pushed now constructs the rebound context, persists FIRST, only then assigns self.context, then applies the transition. A failed persistence leaves both disk and memory on the OLD head; the state machine stays in REPAIRING_REVIEW_FINDINGS. save_run_context_for is the test-only injection seam. 1 new failure-injection test asserts byte-equal disk preservation on OSError.

Test quality: removed assertRaises(Exception) where a specific outcome is required; removed source-text substring matchers; removed the public require_oid_reachable=False bypass. The gate test seam is a private _set_live_fetchers + private _set_bypass_oid_reachability helper that production code MUST NOT call.
